activity.role: Commander-in-chief and de facto head of government
activity.notes: After President Tang Jingsong fled on 6 June 1895, Liu Yongfu became the de facto leader of the Republic of Formosa from Tainan while continuing to style himself commander-in-chief rather than formally accepting the presidency. He fled on 20 October, the eve of Tainan's fall.

sources.title: Japan Center for Asian Historical Records — Republic of Formosa
sources.citation_text: JACAR states that after Tang fled, Liu Yongfu replaced him as leader of the Republic and its armed forces and directed the resistance from Tainan.

sources.title: JACAR Glossary — Liu Yongfu
sources.citation_text: JACAR identifies Liu as head of government after Tang's flight, without formal presidential title, and records his flight on 20 October 1895.
